title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. translated_title: EASE：面向自进化智能体的行为自适应技能筛选框架
translated_abstract: 智能体技能为自进化智能体提供了一种轻量级机制，使其无需更新模型参数即可积累可复用的程序性知识。然而，现有的习得式技能筛选器通常在不显式建模下游执行器行为的情况下优化筛选过程。我们证明这会导致系统性的跨执行器性能退化：使用不同执行器训练的筛选器在与各自训练时的执行器配对时表现最佳，这表明有效的技能筛选依赖于执行器。我们提出了行为自适应技能筛选问题，并引入EASE框架，该框架学习一个能够根据不同执行器行为调整决策的单一筛选器。EASE维护一个在线行为画像，记录最近的执行模式，并将该画像、当前轨迹以及检索到的技能作为筛选器的条件输入，从而在不断演化的技能库中添加、修改或移除技能。我们在多个……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出EASE框架，通过维护在线行为画像使单一技能筛选器自适应不同下游执行器的行为，解决了技能筛选中的跨执行器系统性退化问题。
en_tdlr: EASE is a behavior-adaptive skill curation framework that trains a single curator conditioned on online behavioral profiles to adapt its skill management decisions to different executor behaviors, addressing systematic cross-executor degradation in self-evolving agents.
